title: Relationships Before Transactions
text: The immediate deal matters. The relationship that remains after it matters more.

title: Curiosity Before Certainty
text: Certainty can end a conversation. Curiosity gives it somewhere to go.

title: The Contract Is the Beginning
text: The signature records an agreement. What happens afterwards determines its value.

title: Share Credit Generously
text: Good work becomes stronger when people feel their contribution was seen.

title: Make Working With You Easier
text: Reliability is often remembered more clearly than brilliance.

title: Listen Before Leading
text: Direction improves when it begins with an honest understanding of where people are.
